preamble: Voicing of the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ] to its voiced counterpart [ɮ] keeps the lateral fricative articulation and adds vocal-fold vibration. In Central Chadic it is the defining innovation of the South sub-branch: Proto-Central Chadic *ɬ became *ɮ in every position in the ancestor of the Tera, Bata, Sukur, Mafa and Daba groups, while the North and Hurza sub-branches keep [ɬ]. The Meri subgroup of the Mofu group made the same change independently in palatalized roots.
